description:
£145 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to bring to the student lettings market this stylish and well-proportioned four bedroom terraced house on Clayton Park Square, Jesmond.

Ideally located within walking distance of Jesmond Metro Station, the popular bars and restaurants of Osborne Road, and both Newcastle and Northumbria Universities, this property is perfectly suited to student living.

The house boasts four spacious double bedrooms and generous communal living areas, alongside a long galley-style kitchen and a private gravelled patio to the rear, providing an ideal space for relaxing and socialising.

Situated in one of Jesmond-s most sought-after student locations, this property is not to be missed.

Early viewing is highly recommended. To arrange your viewing, contact My Property Box today and speak to our Lettings Team.
